dedupe_keys.name: myanmar department of population 2024 population and housing census appendix tables on housing characteristics walls roof floor lighting energy cooking fuel drinking water water collection sanitation solid waste by state or region and urban and rural area

description: Myanmar's Department of Population publishes appendix tables of the 2024 Population and Housing Census as Excel workbooks, and the housing characteristics workbook holds 19 tables of households by state or region and by urban and rural area. They cover housing unit type, the materials of walls, roof and floor, ownership, rooms, cooking arrangements, the main source of energy for lighting, cooking fuel, communication and transport items, drinking water source, where water is collected and how long it takes, sanitation type and sharing, handwashing and solid waste services. Coverage is national; the lighting table counts 7,780,926 households, of which 5,162,871 use grid electricity and 1,540,359 solar energy, with rural households far more reliant on solar and batteries. Format and access: free XLSX download, no registration; the 2014 census has township reports, a REDATAM offline package and a microdata request form. Licence: not stated on the pages read. Caveats: tables stop at state or region level; the online 2014 REDATAM server did not answer from the cloud. Simulation uses: grid and off-grid electricity shares for energy access planning, and wall and roof materials for cyclone and earthquake exposure. Related records: the ECLAC REDATAM hub, which lists the Myanmar 2014 database.

schema_summary: Workbook with a list of tables and sheets B-1 to B-19: housing unit type, external wall, roof and floor materials, ownership, rooms, bedrooms, cooking facility location, main source of lighting (grid electricity, private generator, solar, wind and water mill, kerosene, candle, rechargeable battery), cooking fuel, communication items, transport items, improved and unimproved drinking water, place of water collection and time, sanitation type, shared sanitation, handwashing facility, solid waste service. Rows: Union, urban, rural, then each state or region with urban and rural rows.
